name: Memphis Rebuild Rust
description: Rebuild the Memphis NAPI binary after Rust crate changes and verify the runtime will actually load the new code. Use whenever files under crates/ have been modified — the TS host loads crates/memphis-napi/index.node at module-load time and ESM caches it, so Rust source edits are silent until the binary is rebuilt.
workflow: CHECK THE DELTA: compare the mtime of crates/memphis-napi/index.node with the timestamp of the newest commit under crates/. If the commit is newer, the runtime is stale.
BUILD: run npm run build:rust, which builds the workspace through scripts/run-rust.sh and copies the NAPI shared library into crates/memphis-napi/index.node.
RESTART: restart the memphis service so the new binary is loaded, then confirm with memphis health.
VERIFY: run the Rust tests for the touched crate (npm run test:rust) and one TS-level smoke check of the behaviour that was broken.
promptHints: This is the number one source of 'I changed the code but Memphis still behaves the old way'.
A local checkout ships Rust source only — CI builds artifacts upstream, so a git pull that touches crates/ leaves the local binary stale.
npm run build:rust builds the workspace; npm run build:rust:release additionally produces the release artifact.

examples.prompt: Zmieniłem crates/memphis-core, Memphis wciąż zachowuje się jak przed zmianą
examples.outcome: The skill confirms the binary is older than the commit, rebuilds the workspace, restarts the service and verifies the behaviour that was broken.

notes: Tier 0: build tooling only, no vault and no passphrase.
The paths trigger for this skill is crates/**/*.rs and crates/**/Cargo.toml.
